نستحيي (form X)
# نَسْتَحْيِي (nastaḥyī) /nas.taħ.jiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# نَسْتَحْيِيَ (nastaḥyiya) /nas.taħ.ji.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
